extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: Now, what matters most to you — keeping your doctors, or the lowest premium?
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed all compliance rules, including delivering the disclaimer before discussing benefits and collecting the Scope of Appointment immediately after. The customer chose to keep their doctors, and the agent scheduled a plan review for 72 hours later.
composition.coaching_note: Great job, Priya! You adhered to all compliance rules and effectively guided the customer to choose a plan that aligns with their needs. One improvement could be to ensure the customer has a clear understanding of the plan details before scheduling the review.

crm_record.next_step: Review plan with customer in 72 hours
